parsed.rationale: This looks like a ventricular paced rhythm: sharp pacing spikes appear before broad QRS complexes with an LBBB-like shape (deep S waves in V1-V3, notched R waves in I, aVL and V6) and a superior axis, which fits pacing from the right ventricle. The ST elevation in V1-V3 runs opposite to the QRS and is in proportion to it, so it does not meet STEMI or Sgarbossa criteria.
